description: One owner for "what did this cost", which every sink READS rather than re-derives. Supersedes COMP-PRICING: that feature was filed as a pricing problem, and tracing proved pricing is the small part. One measurement at the connector currently fans out to FIVE independent running totals over different event populations with nothing reconciling them — `usageTotals` (result-normalizer, per step), `accumulator.usd` (persisted sidecar, all nine `recordBuildUsage` sites), `buildCostTotals` (in-memory, ONE site: `build.js:5273-5275`, main steps only), routing receipts (per dispatch), and build-stream events. MEASURED on the retained live-fire run: the ledger and the accumulators agree to the cent at $1.4257732 (delta 0.0000000000) while `build-history.jsonl` reports $1.38900475 and 589,373 tokens against the accumulator's 808,002 — short $0.0367685 (2.6% of spend) and 218,629 tokens (27.1%). Evidence: `docs/features/COMP-COST-OWNER/evidence/three-totals-2026-09-12.md`. Cause: fix/revise/gate-fix/error-carried spend reaches the accumulator and the ledger but never `buildCostTotals`, and `buildCostTotals` is SEEDED from the accumulator at `:3746-3749` on every invocation including resume, so the history cost depends on whether the build was resumed (read-verified, not yet measured). Each sink arrived with a different feature (COMP-OBS-COST, COMP-MODEL-AB, COMP-MODEL-ROUTE, resume support), none found an owner to read from, and each added a defensive `?? 0` that silently converts "unknown" to "free" — five times between measurement and display, ending at `<$0.001` on the cockpit for a call of unknown cost. The receipt path (`build.js:2280-2283`) already does this correctly, stripping an unprovenanced dollar rather than inventing provenance, and is the model. Carries forward from COMP-PRICING: the dialect-as-data pricer, the pinned-registry freshness check (ccusage ships exactly this shape), and deleting the unreachable consumer-side fallback.
phase: COMP-COST-OWNER: One owner for the cost number

links.note: Superseded same day. COMP-PRICING scoped the problem as three duplicate price tables; tracing set-site to read-site proved pricing is nearly solved and the real defect is that nothing owns the cost number. Measured: history is short $0.0367685 and 218,629 tokens against a ledger and accumulator that agree to the cent.

Surfaced 2026-09-12 during COMP-MODEL-ROUTE S1b gate-5 work. The usd_source fix exposed the dialect disagreement; tracing it exposed the ownership defect. The gate-5 ledger is also the measuring stick that proved history diverges, and the receipt path is the reference implementation this feature copies.
